scope: Primary documentation and read-only inspection of the user-opened Tiger Lab mobile interface; no API calls, subscriptions, orders or return replication.

observed: ROE and long-term debt/equity contribute to a quality ranking
moving-average crossing and momentum weakening guide entry and exit
missing: factor definitions and point-in-time accounting inputs

otherStrategies: Multi-factor describes quantitative daily signals without a reproducible formula
Trend strategy describes entries after pullbacks in an uptrend without thresholds
Quantitative selection describes financial and historical statistical inputs without weights
tiger.statistics: List cards and detail cards use different metrics, including average return, annualized return and win rate. No displayed performance number was copied into Books or independently verified.
tiger.api: The official scanner supports custom filters for US/HK/SG/AU, cursor pagination and at most 200 results per page. This does not establish access to Tiger Lab model signals or A-share coverage.
tiger.redistribution: Login visibility and OpenAPI permission do not establish public redistribution rights. Books does not scrape or republish the account-visible signal list.
